newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy wants hard core investors for Stet.
newsitem.headline: Italy wants hard core investors for Stet.

text.p: Italy hopes a "hard core" of shareholders will be formed when it privatises telecoms group Stet, Treasury Minister Carlo Azeglio Ciampi said on Wednesday.
He told the transport and telecommunications commission of parliament that it would be sufficient for such a group to hold around 10 percent of Stet's stock.
"The government wants a stable group, a hard core of shareholders," he said.
Ciampi told the commission that the government expected to float Stet by the autumn.
He said a previously announced fusion of Stet with telecoms holding Telecom Italia would be completed by June at the latest.
Under the fusion, Telecom Italia will be merged into Stet and the new group named Telecom Italia.
Ciampi also said Stet had to strengthen its position in the international marketplace.
